name: Daylight world setup
description: Set world and sun baseline for outdoor scenes.
quality_hints: 先建立可用基础光照，再微调强度/颜色，避免一次性过度调参。

name: Camera placement and activation
description: Add and activate camera with scene-aware placement.
quality_hints: 相机创建后需确认 active camera 已切换成功。

name: Light create and tweak
description: Create or modify light objects for better shading.
quality_hints: 灯光调整以主光、辅光分层进行，避免整体过平。

name: Subdivision workflow
description: Add subdivision modifier and set levels.
quality_hints: 细分级别建议区分 viewport 与 render，避免视口过重。

name: Bevel workflow
description: Add bevel modifier with width/segments tuning.
quality_hints: 倒角宽度应与模型尺度匹配，避免边缘发糊。

name: Array workflow
description: Add array modifier and tune count/offset.
quality_hints: Array 调整后优先检查数量与偏移是否符合预期。

name: Duplicate and parent
description: Duplicate object and establish hierarchy.
quality_hints: 建立父子关系后需确认层级正确，避免循环依赖。

name: Visibility control
description: Toggle object visibility in viewport and render.
quality_hints: 可见性操作后需同步检查 viewport/render 两种状态。

name: EEVEE refraction setup
description: Enable EEVEE settings needed by transmissive materials.
quality_hints: 开启 SSR/Refraction 后，再验证材质透射是否生效。

name: Controller copy location
description: Create controller empty and bind copy-location constraint to target object.
quality_hints: 约束前确认 owner/target 都存在，优先使用 Empty 作为控制器。
influence 建议从 0.5 逐步调到 1.0，避免突变。

name: Controller track-to aiming
description: Use Track To constraint for look-at and aim workflows.
quality_hints: track_axis/up_axis 要与对象朝向约定一致，避免翻转。
目标与被约束对象不要重合。

name: Geometry Nodes bootstrap
description: Create GN modifier and inspect initial node graph.
quality_hints: 先创建并确认 Geometry 输入输出，再追加功能节点。
每次改图后都读取摘要，防止链路断开。

name: Geometry Nodes add and link
description: Incrementally add Geometry Nodes and wire sockets.
quality_hints: 先查 socket 名称再连线，避免无效连接。
复杂图采用分段构建，每段后验证。

name: Geometry Nodes parameterization
description: Expose group inputs and set node defaults for controllable GN assets.
quality_hints: 参数命名应表达语义（如 Density/Scale/Seed）。
默认值设置在稳定范围，减少异常几何。

name: Controller Child-Of stack
description: Create Child Of constraint and fine tune/remove it safely.
quality_hints: Child Of 建立后先低影响值验证，再逐步提升到目标值。
复杂绑定优先保留可回滚路径，必要时移除后重建。

name: Object select and linked duplicate
description: Rename object, set active selection, and create linked duplicates.
quality_hints: 重命名后立即用查询工具确认名称一致，避免后续引用失败。
关联复制共享数据块，适合批量布局与实例化。

name: Geometry Nodes maintenance tools
description: Maintain GN graph by removing nodes, auto layout, and type lookup.
quality_hints: 删除节点前先查找类型与连接关系，避免误删主链节点。
复杂节点图每次大改后执行自动布局，提升可读性。

name: Timeline control
description: Set animation frame range and current frame for deterministic keyframe workflow.
quality_hints: 先统一帧率和帧范围，再插关键帧，避免时间错位。
切换关键帧前设置 current frame，减少误操作。

name: Modifier apply pipeline
description: Add or tune modifiers and apply finalized modifier stack.
quality_hints: 应用修改器前先检查参数和对象类型，避免不可逆错误。
建议先复制对象再 apply，保留回滚版本。

name: Save and export scene files
description: Persist scene to .blend and export FBX/glTF deliverables.
quality_hints: 导出前先保存 .blend，确保状态可追溯。
按目标引擎选择 GLB 或 GLTF_SEPARATE 并校验路径。
